keyPhrases.text: I can't say enough about this wonderful production
as truthful and pure as only theatre can be

reasoning: This is an unqualified rave review with superlatives throughout ('bravura,' 'superlative,' 'flawless,' 'wonderful'). The critic explicitly states 'I can't say enough about this wonderful production' and uses no negative criticisms. The review ends with the highest praise comparing it to the pure essence of theater.
